mechanism_narrative: A higher federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 5.0% predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to increased discount rates on equity cash flows and reduced corporate borrowing capacity.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 5.0%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 3.5% signals labor market overheating that triggers wage inflation and monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE < 3.5%, or the Rank IC over the last 2 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent increases in housing starts (HOUST) and real personal consumption (RSAFS) above their 12-month moving averages indicate robust consumer demand that precedes corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (both series above 12mo_MA) fails to produce positive 20d returns in > 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 signals an economic contraction that reduces corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days during recessionary regimes.
failure_condition: In INDPRO < 100 periods, SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of cases, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Higher quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) above 2.0% indicates strong economic expansion that supports corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for GDPC1 as a predictor of 20d SPX returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation above 3.5% (CPIAUCSL) signals persistent inflation that triggers aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.5%, or the Rank IC over the last 2 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent increases in payroll employment (PAYEMS) above 12-month moving average and declines in unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 12-month moving average indicate labor market overheating that drives wage inflation and monetary tightening, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (PAYEMS above 12mo_MA and UNRATE below 12mo_MA) fails to produce negative 20d returns in > 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Housing market downturns (HOUST below 1200 thousand units) signal reduced consumer spending and economic uncertainty, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days during housing downturn regimes.
failure_condition: In HOUST < 1200 periods, SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of cases, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.
